purpose: Map work tasks to human, AI, robotic, and combined execution roles so Buddy can recommend the safest and most effective collaboration for each user's goal.

source_scope.limitation: The occupational reference describes human work, worker requirements, tasks, and contexts. It does not itself establish AI or robot capability, nor prove that any person is qualified.

allocation_agents.name: Human
allocation_agents.scope: A person performing, supervising, deciding, creating, caring, or taking accountable action.
strengths: embodied perception and dexterity in unstructured real environments
empathy, trust-building, care, and nuanced interpersonal relationships
contextual judgment where values, ambiguity, and consequences matter
accountability, consent, and legally assigned professional authority when qualified
adaptation to novel physical situations using lived experience
constraints: fatigue, limited attention, memory and throughput
risk of injury and exposure to hazards
availability, cost, and variation in training or experience

allocation_agents.name: AI software
allocation_agents.scope: A digital model or agent operating through authorized software, data, and tools.
strengths: high-volume information retrieval, synthesis, translation, and drafting
rapid pattern analysis across large digital datasets
repeatable calculations, code assistance, simulation, and optimization
continuous digital monitoring and workflow orchestration when connected
scalable personalization and explanation across knowledge levels
constraints: may be wrong, outdated, biased, or overconfident
cannot independently establish truth, consent, legal authority, or professional licensure
cannot physically manipulate the world without connected actuators and verified systems
depends on data quality, tool access, permissions, and security boundaries

allocation_agents.name: Physical robot or automated machine
allocation_agents.scope: A physical system with sensors, actuators, control software, and a defined operating environment.
strengths: repeatable physical movement and manipulation within validated tolerances
continuous operation in suitable environments
measured force, positioning, inspection, and material handling
performing hazardous, dirty, heavy, or ergonomically harmful operations when specifically engineered and certified
constraints: limited by hardware, payload, reach, battery, sensing, calibration, and environment
physical safety, maintenance, and emergency-stop requirements
does not independently supply human empathy, moral accountability, or professional authorization

allocation_agents.name: Human + AI
allocation_agents.scope: A person directs and verifies AI-assisted digital work.
strengths: human intent and judgment combined with AI speed and breadth
faster research, drafting, analysis, planning, coding, and decision support
human review of uncertainty, exceptions, and consequential outcomes
constraints: requires clear responsibility, source checking, privacy controls, and review effort

allocation_agents.name: Human + robot
allocation_agents.scope: A person works alongside or supervises a physical robotic system.
strengths: human adaptation and situational awareness combined with machine precision, strength, or endurance
shared physical workflows with human intervention for exceptions
constraints: requires task-specific safety engineering, training, separation or collaboration controls, and emergency procedures

allocation_agents.name: AI + robot
allocation_agents.scope: AI planning or perception is connected to robotic hardware.
strengths: digital perception and planning connected to physical sensing and action
automated inspection, logistics, manipulation, and adaptive physical workflows in validated environments
constraints: requires verified sensors, actuators, control limits, fail-safe behavior, and environment-specific testing

allocation_agents.name: Human + AI + robot
allocation_agents.scope: A person retains direction and accountability while AI supports perception/planning and robots perform validated physical actions.
strengths: combines human judgment, digital intelligence, and physical execution
supports complex workflows with explicit human checkpoints and exception handling
constraints: highest integration complexity; safety case, security, audit trail, and fallback operation required

suitability_classes.meaning: Human performs the core task; AI or robot may provide bounded assistance.
AI prepares or analyzes work; a human verifies before consequential use.
Software may execute a bounded digital workflow with explicit permissions, tests, logs, and rollback.
A robot performs a validated physical subtask with human supervision and safety controls.
Human and AI divide the work according to strengths, with clear handoffs.
Human and robot share a physical workflow under engineered safety controls.
Human, AI, and robot coordinate a multi-stage workflow with explicit responsibility and safe fallback.
Only appropriately qualified and authorized people may perform or sign off the task; AI/robot use is limited to permitted support.
Evidence is insufficient to recommend autonomous execution.

allocation_rules: Classify the requested task, not an entire occupation, before selecting an executor.
Break occupations into task steps and assign different roles to different steps where appropriate.
Use AI for digital work only when data, model, tools, and permissions are adequate and validated.
Use robots only when the exact hardware, payload, sensors, workspace, operating conditions, and safety controls are verified.
Keep humans responsible for consent, values, high-impact decisions, exceptions, and legally required professional judgment.
Require qualified human review for regulated, safety-critical, medical, legal, financial, employment, or other high-impact tasks as applicable.
If evidence, credentials, hardware, permissions, or environmental conditions are unknown, choose not_assessed or human_led.
Never infer an individual's ability, disability, personality, employability, or qualification from occupational averages.
Ask the user about goals, preferred level of automation, accessibility needs, budget, privacy, and desired human involvement when these affect the allocation.
Re-evaluate the allocation when tools, models, hardware, regulations, data, or task conditions change.

initial_task_examples.human_role: set question, verify critical claims and decide
initial_task_examples.evidence_needed: citation accuracy and held-out research benchmark

initial_task_examples.ai_role: analyze sensor/video feeds and flag anomalies
initial_task_examples.human_role: set safety plan and approve response
initial_task_examples.robot_role: enter and collect sensor readings if the platform is certified for the environment
initial_task_examples.evidence_needed: environment-specific safety case, sensor validation, detection performance, emergency recovery

initial_task_examples.task: Provide emotional support to a distressed person
initial_task_examples.ai_role: offer optional information and help locate support
initial_task_examples.human_role: provide empathy, relationship, judgment, and escalation
initial_task_examples.evidence_needed: safeguarding, consent, escalation, and human oversight

initial_task_examples.ai_role: draft code, tests, and review findings in a sandbox
initial_task_examples.human_role: define requirements, review diff, approve merge and release
initial_task_examples.evidence_needed: tests, security checks, regression suite, reviewer acceptance

initial_task_examples.task: Move standardized materials in a mapped warehouse
initial_task_examples.human_role: supervise, handle exceptions, and maintain safety
initial_task_examples.robot_role: transport materials within validated payload and navigation limits
initial_task_examples.evidence_needed: route success, collision avoidance, payload limits, uptime, emergency stop

coverage_policy.occupation_and_task_mapping: Every task statement in the verified source release must receive a task record or an explicit exclusion/review reason.

truth_boundary: This is a decision framework and initial illustrative examples, not a completed scan of every occupation or task, not proof that AI or robots can perform the tasks, and not a qualification or certification.
